name: io.github.Orrae-Labs/open-diagram-rs
title: open-diagram-rs
description: Draws architecture diagrams from JSON or Mermaid.

environmentVariables.name: OPEN_DIAGRAM_RS_OUT
environmentVariables.description: Folder for SVG and PNG files. The default is ./open-diagram-rs when that directory is writable.

environmentVariables.name: OPEN_DIAGRAM_RS_ICONS
environmentVariables.description: Extra icon folders, split on the system path separator. Built-in icons are always included.

environmentVariables.name: OPEN_DIAGRAM_RS_SKILLS
environmentVariables.description: Folder of Agent Skills to serve. Without it, the server serves skills/ when that folder is visible.

environmentVariables.name: CHROME
environmentVariables.description: Path to Chrome, Chromium, or Edge when PNG rendering cannot find a browser.
